About this book

When Mark leaves Alexa to marry her best friend, her plans for the future collapse. His brother Scott Kelsey is concerned about the effect of the scandal on the family's reputation. Alexa then marries Scott as a way of saving face, despite the hurt surrounding the arrangement.

The story follows a relationship formed in the shadow of another man's rejection, with family expectations and Alexa's unresolved feelings at its centre.

About this book

Ryū Murakami depicts a circle of young friends living in a Japanese town near an American military base. Drug use, sexual encounters and episodes of violence shape their routines and strain their connections with one another.

The novel uses sharply focused physical sensations and fragmented experiences to portray their unstable world. Its subject is the destructive pattern of these lives and the difficulty of finding a lasting sense of connection.

Over dit boek

Mirjam Blits vertelt hoe zij en haar man in februari 1943 worden opgepakt en hoe zij de Duitse concentratiekampen doorstaat. Na haar terugkeer in Amsterdam begint zij haar ervaringen op te schrijven, terwijl zij het verlies van haar man en familie onder ogen moet zien.

Haar herinneringen gaan over geweld en ontbering, maar ook over de steun tussen meisjes en jonge vrouwen. Zo legt zij vast hoe zij elkaar tijdens de gevangenschap proberen overeind te houden.

Bron: Just Publishers
